depth.primary: restrained tactile depth; approximately translateY(3px) on press
depth.tile: soft standing depth where an interactive DOM surface needs separation
depth.arcade: Home mode-card exception only; do not propagate through Spatial navigation

homeChooser.composition: one bounded centred surface over the full world globe, no wider than its four modes need; 2x2 modes on ordinary phone portrait and compact adaptation in short landscape
homeChooser.surface: neutral translucent surface at roughly 82% with a thin structural edge and modest depth, so the planet reads through it
homeChooser.blur: none by default; backdrop-filter is not required
homeChooser.fallback: solid real-DOM surface in forced colours or wherever translucency is unsuitable

principles: Geography is the content; interface is the instrument
Cartography carries the colour and chrome stays neutral: land green, water blue, space night, panels and backgrounds unchanged
One central cartography token family serves the globe, Locations and Neighbours; no consumer sheet forks it
Evidence fills geography in, and immediate answer feedback still outranks every stored state
Game feel decorates states the DOM already carries in words and shape, so removing the whole layer leaves the round correct
Spatial Atlas is the default production navigation presentation, not a preview
Navigation stays mode-first: choose domain, select continent or region on the Earth, then deliberately choose Play or Learn
Political detail is progressively disclosed: continents at world level, a framed continent's areas next, country boundaries only where the activity is about countries
Continent and area shells are the canonical country geometry with shared edges cancelled; no second geography source, hand-drawn shell or mask

Each currently selectable scope is named on the Earth by a real focusable control with a full-size touch target, never by text baked into the scene, and a name that has nowhere truthful to sit stands down
Spatial Home lets the full world globe own the canvas and layers one centred icon-led mode chooser over it
The Spatial Home chooser is the sole neutral translucency exception; no nested glass, decorative blur, glow or gradients, and other Spatial command surfaces remain non-translucent
The typed route is authoritative; camera and globe state interpret navigation rather than owning a second stack
The conventional launcher is renderer-failure fallback only and must remain semantically equivalent
Atlas is mobile-first, low-friction and information-first, and gamified only inside a round
Atlas Blue drives ordinary action and progress while green and red stay correctness feedback, deeper and more saturated than any land green
Region-by-domain Mastery is purple; gold is deliberately scarce completion/prestige
Country records are live learning evidence, not learner-facing prestige objects
Ordinary progress is a quiet two-segment successful-retrieval strip in the mode's own accent rather than a mastery dashboard
Complete regions use restrained gold; complete continents use persisted crest/trophy state; genuine world completion alone earns the Crown
A single Perfect round is transient result feedback and is not persistent Mastery
The dedicated Progress screen is retired; progress is disclosed in the learning/navigation flow rather than a dashboard
Real DOM controls remain equivalent to spatial selection; no colour-only or 3D-only state
Tiny geography uses truthful display geometry and source-derived invisible interaction envelopes when necessary
Mobile edge gestures, reduced motion and answer-safe accessibility remain first-class
No continent, region or hemisphere colour taxonomy; a domain accent is mode identity and reaches only its own icon and meter
No default glassmorphism, bento dashboards, decorative UI overload, currencies, levels, daily-streak obligations or any reward economy
